passages.original: ξζʹ. Φιλήμων, πρὸς ὃν καὶ ἐπιστολὴν ἔγραψεν, ὃς καὶ ἐπίσκοπος Γάζης γέγονεν.
passages.english: 67. Philemon, to whom [Paul] also wrote a letter, and who also became bishop of Gaza.
passages.notes: ξζʹ is the list number 67. The subject of ἔγραψεν is unexpressed; Paul is presumably meant, as in the Epistle to Philemon.
